detailed_descriptions.en: 🗑️ Welcome to the Dump You lost your Bitcoin. It's in here somewhere. So is a lot of other people's garbage. Start digging, start selling, and don't stop until the dump is yours. WHERE the F$CK is my BITCOIN ⁉️ is a co-op incremental sim about turning a mountain of garbage into a money machine. Dig piles by hand, sort treasure from trash, sell everything that isn't nailed down — then dump the cash straight back into faster gear and dirtier dumps. Play solo and zone out, or squad up with friends and turn the dump into a circus. One more pile. One more upgrade. One more run. 💰 Features Dig, sort, sell, repeat. Every pile is either worthless junk or the find that fixes your whole life. Usually junk. Upgrade everything. Faster hands, bigger bags, more stamina. Turn one sad guy with a trash bag into a junk-hauling machine. Unlock new dumps. Each landfill is dirtier, deeper, and richer than the last. Co-op chaos. Bring friends. Split the loot, or "accidentally" grab the shiny thing first. Friendship not guaranteed. About that Bitcoin… It's still out there. Probably.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
🗑️ Welcome to the Dump

You lost your Bitcoin. It's in here somewhere. So is a lot of other people's garbage. Start digging, start selling, and don't stop until the dump is yours.


WHERE the F$CK is my BITCOIN ⁉️ is a co-op incremental sim about turning a mountain of garbage into a money machine. Dig piles by hand, sort treasure from trash, sell everything that isn't nailed down — then dump the cash straight back into faster gear and dirtier dumps. Play solo and zone out, or squad up with friends and turn the dump into a circus. One more pile. One more upgrade. One more run.

💰 Features

  • Dig, sort, sell, repeat.

    Every pile is either worthless junk or the find that fixes your whole life. Usually junk.

  • Upgrade everything.

    Faster hands, bigger bags, more stamina. Turn one sad guy with a trash bag into a junk-hauling machine.

  • Unlock new dumps.

    Each landfill is dirtier, deeper, and richer than the last.

  • Co-op chaos.

    Bring friends. Split the loot, or "accidentally" grab the shiny thing first. Friendship not guaranteed.

  • About that Bitcoin…

    It's still out there. Probably.
